title: lib/constants.sh is not the one home for paths and defaults that the docs say it is
objective: ARCHITECTURE.md, MODULES.md and DECISION_TREE.md say that `lib/constants.sh` holds every configurable path and default. Some live elsewhere, mostly test seams: `lib/liberator.sh:6`, `lib/molt.sh:1468`, `1484` and `1492`, `liberators/backup.sh:59-60`, `keys.sh:7`, `tiling.sh:17` and `editors.sh:409`. Move each into `lib/constants.sh`, or make those docs name test seams as the one exception.
